thesis: Property technology is becoming a digital operating system for the built environment: governed data, connected workflows, physical evidence, customer and partner interfaces, bounded intelligence and accountable human control.
supportingArguments: Adoption is broad while scaled, measured value remains rare.
Data quality, change capability, interoperability and governance determine whether AI or automation can create durable value.
Construction, energy, climate, finance and physical workflows belong inside the PropTech analysis; a listings-only definition is too narrow.
Regional context changes transferability: Bangladesh, South Asia, MENA, Japan, Southeast Asia, Europe, Australia and North America are not interchangeable markets.
Negative and restructured cases are necessary to distinguish technology survival, company survival and business-model risk.
The most disciplined JCX innovation path is a measured venture-client pilot before a separate investment decision.
thesisCaveats: This is a decision-useful curated corpus, not a census or market-share estimate.
Most company scale, adoption and outcome figures are self-reported or vendor/customer reported.
The thesis is an atlas synthesis, not a claim that all included technologies form one product category.

entity.description: Demonstrates that digital experience cannot repair fixed leases, utilization and capital-structure exposure.

case.baselineProblem: Algorithmic home buying accumulated inventory exposed to price/renovation and operational risk
case.intervention: Zillow wound down Offers and sold inventory after deciding the model’s volatility/forecasting risk was too high
case.measuredOutcome: $407.9M inventory write-down in 2021; Offers wind-down charges primarily recorded in Homes segment
case.periodSampleDenominator: FY2021 SEC filing; reported accounting amount, not an operational KPI.
case.causalCaveat: This is a high-confidence accounting fact; it does not prove software alone caused the loss—market, pricing and operating model all mattered.
case.transferability: Critical JCX guardrail: do not automate land/property acquisition without human underwriting, inventory limits and exit triggers.

case.baselineProblem: Asset-light branding paired with long fixed lease obligations and rapid expansion created structural mismatch
case.intervention: Chapter 11 restructuring rationalized leases and capital structure
case.measuredOutcome: Approximately $1.5B debt cancelled/equitized and $1.6B maturities extended in 2023 agreement; later emergence reported more than $4B debt shed and future lease obligations cut in half
case.periodSampleDenominator: 2023 restructuring agreement and 2024 emergence; restructuring figures are company/filing reported.
case.causalCaveat: Financial restructuring is not a PropTech ROI; macro office demand and lease terms were primary drivers.
case.transferability: JCX lesson: technology must improve asset economics and flexibility; never confuse a polished digital layer with sustainable unit economics.

caveats: Accounting or restructuring evidence establishes events and losses, not that software alone caused them.
openQuestions: Which controls should accompany each failure case so the lesson is actionable rather than sensational?

beats.title: A protocol is not semantic truth; an API is not a process

standard.name: Industry Foundation Classes (IFC)
standard.solves: Open exchange of BIM lifecycle data across authoring and FM tools
standard.adoption: High as exchange standard; implementation quality varies
standard.jcxImplication: Require IFC 4.3 deliverables with model-view and property validation
standard.caveat: Valid IFC may still omit operational properties or lose relationships

standard.name: Information Delivery Specification (IDS)
standard.solves: Machine-readable information requirements and automated IFC validation
standard.jcxImplication: Attach IDS to every design procurement construction and handover gate
standard.caveat: Validates declared model content not physical truth; poor requirements remain valid

standard.name: BIM Collaboration Format (BCF)
standard.solves: Portable model issue and clash coordination without proprietary model files
standard.jcxImplication: Make issues first-class records linked to IFC GUIDs and evidence
standard.caveat: Issue layer is not full document/change control; test API versus file support

standard.name: buildingSMART Data Dictionary (bSDD)
standard.solves: Stable multilingual classes properties values and relations for built environment terms
standard.license: Free service with terms/licensing by publisher
standard.jcxImplication: Use URIs and versioned API mappings plus JCX Bangladesh extension
standard.caveat: Content/API versions change; cache terms and never rely on unversioned identifier URLs

standard.name: OSCRE Industry Data Model
standard.statusOrVersion: 130+ use cases public description; current home references 150+
standard.solves: Common enterprise real-estate investment occupier lease vocabulary and schemas
standard.adoption: Industry-led and broad; full IDM requires registration/license
standard.jcxImplication: Map leases units parties investments procurement and portfolio data to OSCRE
standard.caveat: Do not force enterprise model into IFC geometry; access and version terms apply

standard.name: OGC API Features
standard.solves: Feature-level REST/OpenAPI access to parcels buildings roads permits and amenities
standard.adoption: Approved open standard; modern API family
standard.jcxImplication: Use for spatial search/query and partner exchange preserving CRS
standard.caveat: Core read scope and implementation parts differ; test CRS/filter/write behavior

caveats: Standards vary by version, adoption and implementation quality; require tested mappings and acceptance criteria.
openQuestions: Which standards crosswalks are mature enough for an implementation-neutral public explanation?

beats.title: Security, privacy, climate and bounded AI

standard.name: ISO/IEC 27001 information security
standard.solves: Confidentiality integrity availability risk management and ISMS controls
standard.jcxImplication: Use for corporate/CDE/cloud supplier controls and audit evidence
standard.caveat: Certification does not guarantee OT safety or correct implementation

standard.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
standard.solves: Govern Identify Protect Detect Respond Recover governance and risk profiles
standard.adoption: High practical adoption; voluntary and adaptable
standard.jcxImplication: Create current/target profiles for IT CDE BMS/OT and vendors
standard.caveat: Framework is outcome-oriented; map controls to actual implementation

standard.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
standard.solves: Voluntary trustworthy AI risk management across design/deploy/use/evaluation
standard.adoption: High practical ecosystem; voluntary and living
standard.jcxImplication: Use for tenant screening maintenance analytics worker/camera and GenAI release gates
standard.caveat: Current framework revision means pin version and record mappings

standard.name: ISO/IEC 42001 AI management system
standard.solves: Organization-wide AI policies risk transparency accountability and continual improvement
standard.adoption: First international AI management-system standard; growing ecosystem
standard.jcxImplication: Create AI inventory risk classification impact assessment logs and human oversight
standard.caveat: Management certification is not model accuracy or fairness proof

standard.name: GHG Protocol Corporate and Scope 3
standard.solves: Boundaries and categories for corporate/value-chain GHG inventories
standard.adoption: Very high global reporting adoption; methodology evolves
standard.jcxImplication: Store activity data factor source period boundary estimation and assurance
standard.caveat: Scope boundary choices can double count; not a property data model

standard.name: Bangladesh Personal Data Protection Ordinance
standard.adoption: Current Bangladesh legal watchlist; counsel required
standard.jcxImplication: Minimize identity data separate marketing/tenant/visitor/CCTV and define retention/access
standard.caveat: Legal status and implementing rules can change; do not treat summary as legal advice

standard.name: Bangladesh National Data Governance Ordinance
standard.solves: National data governance interoperability lifecycle transparency and accountability
standard.adoption: Current Bangladesh legal watchlist; counsel required
standard.jcxImplication: Use data inventory provenance classification stewardship and interoperable exports
standard.caveat: Confirm applicability/authority and amendments before implementation

caveats: Bangladesh privacy, legal, title, finance and security material is issue-spotting, not legal advice. A standard or framework does not establish compliance.
openQuestions: Which local legal/security claims require current counsel review before public copy is drafted?
